module_theorem: For a split finite group of Lie type in defining characteristic, the Steinberg module restricts to one regular module on a Sylow/maximal unipotent p-subgroup U (projective restriction plus dim(St)=|U|).
jennings_formula: In the stated safe prime-field range, Hilb gr_J(F_p[U]) = product over positive roots alpha of (1+t^ht(alpha)+...+t^((p-1)ht(alpha))).

q3_C2_exceptional_anchor.status: exactly computed in Pass5108; same root-height factorization holds at this boundary prime

primary_references: S. A. Jennings, Trans. AMS 50 (1941), 175-185, The Structure of the Group Ring of a p-Group Over a Modular Field
Steinberg defining-characteristic projectivity/regular Sylow restriction; modern Sylow-regular terminology: Malle-Zalesski, Steinberg-like characters for finite simple groups
boundary: The root-height product is promoted in the safe prime-field range (A2 p>2, C2 p>3, G2 p>5) plus the separately computed C2,p=3 anchor. No blanket bad-prime formula or hardware latency interpretation is asserted.
